# Massimo Dutti

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 8 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

Massimo Dutti is a public clothing shop. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://www.massimodutti.com](https://www.massimodutti.com) on 2026-11-22. The market picker geo-selected Singapore and English. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The homepage, the Woman menu, New In, one public product, and About were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

`catalog.json` was left alone. `webapps-manifest.json` was left alone. `login-extracted` was not flipped.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the page white and the type black.** The header, menu, and product column are white. Type is `#000000`. [screenshots/home-light-1440.png](screenshots/home-light-1440.png)
- **Set department labels in small caps.** Nav is Suisse Light 12px, letter-spacing 1.92px, uppercase. [screenshots/nav-woman-light-1440.png](screenshots/nav-woman-light-1440.png)
- **Outline Add to Basket.** It is 32px, white, with a 1px black border and no radius. It was not clicked. [screenshots/product-light-1440.png](screenshots/product-light-1440.png)
- **Paint the market Continue black.** On the picker, Continue is 32px, `#000000` fill, white type. The photographed fill looked grey. [raw/readings.json](raw/readings.json)
